name: BSP_Plane_SweepCollisionPoints

Calls 0084BF00(list, p+72Ch, p, [p+730h], extra, &local) at 007C0C0A. Coverage partial: the per-point water-crossing arm 007C0A4x-007C0C30 is contract: unread. docs/PROJECTILE_HELPERS.md

name: BSP_Sphere_TransformAffine
evidence: [BSP reconstruction] Call007BB620 on matrix, register-input CRT sqrt00BF7030, store scale float, multiply signed source radius and store float before affine center004142E0. Copy XYZ and saved radius with FLD/FSTP. No abs or perspective divide. Finite result/CW parity established for masked nearest CW007F/027F, including harmless masked-inexact CRT path; NaN/domain/unmasked/other CW and full status-word parity remain open. Original ABI: ECX=source float4 sphere; stack[ESP+4]=destination float4, [ESP+8]=matrix; EAX=destination; RET8. Evidence: docs/MODEL_WORLD_BOUNDS.md; reports/model_world_bounds_audit.json. Descriptive names are hypotheses; typed C++ interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.
